parameters.help_en: The tiered price for input tokens (non-cumulative). The value is a JSON array character string. Each element contains Tier and InputCostPointsPerMillion. Valid values for Tier: "" (default tier), 0-32K, 32K-64K, 64K-128K, 128K-256K, 256K-512K, 512K-1M, and 1M+. Example: [{"Tier":"0-32K","InputCostPointsPerMillion":"1000"},{"Tier":"32K-64K","InputCostPointsPerMillion":"1800"}]. If this parameter is provided, it takes precedence over InputCostPointsPerMillion. An empty array [] is not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 输入 Token 阶梯价格(非累进), JSON 数组字符串, 元素含 Tier 和 InputCostPointsPerMillion, Tier 取值 ""(默认档)/0-32K/32K-64K/64K-128K/128K-256K/256K-512K/512K-1M/1M+, 例如 [{"Tier":"0-32K","InputCostPointsPerMillion":"1000"},{"Tier":"32K-64K","InputCostPointsPerMillion":"1800"}]; 提供时优先于 InputCostPointsPerMillion, 不可传 []
parameters.name: input_token_tiers

parameters.help_en: The input token tier. An empty string indicates the default tier. If this parameter is omitted, it is processed by the backend
parameters.help_zh: 输入 Token 档位，空字符串表示默认档位，省略时由后端处理
parameters.name: input_token_tier

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to bypass the quota check. This parameter is optional and has no default value. If omitted, it is not passed through. Both false and true are passed through as-is
parameters.help_zh: 是否跳过配额检查；可选，不设置默认值，省略时不透传，false 与 true 均原样下传
parameters.name: bypass_quota_check

parameters.help_en: The effective start time in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. If this parameter is not provided, the rule takes effect immediately
parameters.help_zh: 生效起始时间, 格式 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, 不传则立即生效
parameters.name: effective_start_time
